name: Tiger Monastery
description: Located atop a cold, hard-to-access mountain, the Tiger Monastery lies hidden within a dense bamboo forest. Although the rigorous cold surrounds the structure, the Ki energy maintains a pleasant temperature within. This structure is built from deep orange and black stones, with some large training grounds and places for meditation. Their main focus is honor, peace, and Ki studies. Legends tell about the Ancient Tiger ofuda, a special technique, capable of improving the Ki channeling beyond common limitations. Also, at night, monks report hearing the Whispering Bamboo, which is said to speak knowledge from ancient times to those who perform tasks to the spirits guarding it. Many families of the Goukuden clan dream of their children being admitted to the Monastery. Annually, the Festival of Tiger Masks displays many combats and admits new students from the most capable ones.
